name: vscode-http-api
description: A minimal VS Code extension that exposes a small HTTP API to programmatically control the workspace and editor (open, edit, save, git commit, run editor commands).

commands.title: VSCode HTTP API: Show Audit Log
VSCode HTTP API: Refresh Audit Log
VSCode HTTP API: Show Audit Details
VSCode HTTP API: Rollback Audit Entry
VSCode HTTP API: Prune Audit Log

vscodeHttpApi.port.description: TCP port where the extension listens for HTTP requests (loopback only unless allowRemote is true).

vscodeHttpApi.apiKey.description: Optional API key for incoming requests to authenticate. If blank, no auth required (not secure).

vscodeHttpApi.allowRemote.description: If true, allow non-loopback remote access. Use with caution and configure firewall/auth.

vscodeHttpApi.allowExec.description: Allow the /exec endpoint which runs shell commands in the workspace host. Requires allowRemote or loopback and careful use.

vscodeHttpApi.execWhitelist.description: Optional whitelist of executable program names allowed to be run by /exec (e.g., ['ls', 'git']). Leave empty to allow any command (not secure).

vscodeHttpApi.masterAutoApprove.description: If true, the extension will provide an endpoint to toggle 'master auto approve' across installed extensions and settings.

vscodeHttpApi.yoloMode.description: If true, the extension will offer endpoints to toggle YOLO mode across extensions/settings. This is dangerous; use with caution.

vscodeHttpApi.autoCommit.description: If true, try to commit files after change endpoints complete, using the workspace's git.

vscodeHttpApi.auditMaxContentLength.description: Maximum number of characters to store for 'before'/'after' file contents in the audit log; longer content is truncated to this length. Set to 0 to store unbounded content.

vscodeHttpApi.auditMaxEntries.description: Maximum number of audit entries to keep in the audit log. Older entries are pruned on new writes. Set to 0 to keep all entries.

vscodeHttpApi.auditRetentionDays.description: Prune audit entries older than specified number of days. Set to 0 to disable time-based pruning.

vscodeHttpApi.enableRateLimiting.description: Enable rate limiting to prevent API abuse (100 requests per minute per client).

vscodeHttpApi.enforceWorkspaceScope.description: Enforce that all file operations must be within the workspace root directory.

vscodeHttpApi.maxRequestSize.description: Maximum size in bytes for HTTP request bodies (default: 5MB).
